description: Fill the empty fields of one company, contact or web link in the user's graph from public data, the same as the Enrich button on its page. A company is looked up by its website, a contact by its LinkedIn profile or email, and a web link is read again for its summary, topics and key facts. Only empty fields are filled; nothing the user wrote is replaced, so it needs no approval. Returns which fields it filled. Use it when the user asks to enrich, fill in or flesh out a specific record. A company with no website can take one in 'domain'. For several records at once, pass up to 200 ids in 'object_ids': cached data fills at once and the rest is looked up in the background, so tell the user the records fill in over the next few minutes. There is a daily limit, so do not run it across the whole graph unasked.

domain.description: The company's website, only for a company that has none yet (e.g. 'saronic.com').

object_id.description: The company, contact or web link to enrich (exact id).

object_ids.description: Several records to enrich at once, in place of object_id.
